pm.test('HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const venue=pm.response.json();const taipei=new Date(new Date(venue.serverTime).getTime()+8*3600000);if(taipei.getUTCHours()>=21)taipei.setUTCDate(taipei.getUTCDate()+1);pm.collectionVariables.set('p5Date',taipei.toISOString().slice(0,10));

item.name: 11 會員不能搶已代訂時段

exec:
pm.test('HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('含代訂與客人電話',()=>{const order=pm.response.json().orders.find(o=>o.id===pm.collectionVariables.get('p5Order'));pm.expect(order.customer.phone).to.eql('0912345678');});

item.name: 22 公開棋盤僅顯示維修狀態

exec:
pm.test('HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const grid=pm.response.json();pm.test('MAINTENANCE',()=>pm.expect(grid.slots.find(s=>s.startAt===pm.collectionVariables.get('p5Start')).status).to.eql('MAINTENANCE'));pm.test('不公開客人或維修理由',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('customer');pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('燈具維修');});
